review_candidates.description: About Northern Hills Technology At Northern Hills Technology, we bridge the gap between complex technology and human success. We are a close-knit team of professionals who understand that every support ticket represents a person trying to do their job. This is an in-person position that will become an integral part of our collaborative environment, where working together is critical to our team success. Our client base is mature, and the issues that reach our team are rarely simple password resets or basic connectivity checks. They typically involve Active Directory and Group Policy questions, Microsoft 365 tenant-level issues, networking and VLAN troubleshooting, and security incidents. This role is responsible for independently diagnosing and resolving the full range of client technical issues — from everyday requests to advanced, escalated-level problems — from the moment a ticket comes in. This role also carries responsibility for the health of the internal tools, platforms, and automation that power our service delivery (RMM, PSA, EDR/security tooling, backup monitoring, documentation systems, and patch management). You will monitor, maintain, and tune these platforms so that alerts are accurate, automation runs cleanly, and the rest of the team can rely on the data these tools produce. You will balance the Core (technical resolution and process) with the Essence (managing client expectations and experience), while also serving as a steward of the internal systems that make our whole service model work. You will use industry-leading tools to document, monitor, and address tickets — and to maintain the health of those same platforms — with a “Today, Not Tomorrow” mindset. Location Requirement This position is based on-site in Spearfish, SD, and requires consistent, in-person presence to support our team and clients effectively. Candidates should currently reside within daily commuting distance of Spearfish, SD, so they can be reliably on-site as needed. If relocation is necessary to meet this requirement, arranging and completing that relocation is the candidate’s responsibility. Key Responsibilities 1. Comprehensive Front-Line Technical Support (The “Core”) Primary Point of Contact: As a member of the Service Desk team, our Service Technicians serve as the primary point of contact (phone, email, portal) for incoming client requests, independently diagnosing and resolving issues on first contact rather than simply routing them elsewhere. Full-Spectrum Troubleshooting & Resolution: Resolve issues across the full technical spectrum — from everyday needs (Windows 10/11, Microsoft 365 apps, printers, basic connectivity) to advanced problems: Active Directory and Group Policy, DNS/DHCP infrastructure, VLANs and switching/routing, VPN configuration, Microsoft 365 tenant administration (Exchange Online, Entra ID, Intune, SharePoint/Teams), security and server administration. Data Capture & Root Cause: Accurately document the client’s issues, environment, and history, and go beyond the immediate fix to identify root causes and recommend permanent remediation rather than repeat workarounds. Workstation & Server Support: Perform workstation imaging/deployment, server administration, and support for cloud/on-prem migration and lifecycle projects as needed. 2. Security & Process Management Lifecycle Management: Manage tickets from intake to resolution, ensuring the client is updated at every step. Documentation: Maintain configurations, network diagrams, and passwords in IT Glue. Partner with our Technology Alignment Managers to keep system documentation current and audit-ready for future troubleshooting. Security Remediation: Review and independently remediate alerts from RMM, EDR, SIEM, and other security monitoring tools — including malware incidents, patch failures, and backup discrepancies — escalating only genuinely novel or high-severity events. MFA & Access Control: Deploy, troubleshoot, and audit MFA and conditional access policies to ensure client data remains protected. 3. Service Delivery Platform Monitoring Tool Stewardship: Monitor and maintain the health of our core service delivery platforms — RMM, PSA, documentation, backup monitoring, and patch management systems. Alert Tuning: Review automated alerts and monitoring policies for accuracy; reduce noise and false positives so the team can trust and act on what these tools report. Automation & Patch Oversight: Monitor patch management cycles and automated remediation scripts across the client base, addressing failures and gaps proactively. Security Tools: Monitor and maintain the health of our core security delivery platforms. Cross-Client Visibility: Use platform data to spot systemic issues or risks across multiple clients, feeding findings back into ticket resolution and long-term recommendations. 4. Client Experience & Communication (The “Essence”) Manage Expectations: Own communication on both routine and complex, high-visibility client issues. A technical fix without communication is a failed ticket. Pattern Recognition: Identify recurring issues — especially security risks — and flag them to the TAM or vCIO to drive long-term, permanent solutions. Client Trust: Act as a trusted technical resource clients can count on to solve problems correctly the first time, regardless of complexity. Success Metrics (How You Will Be Measured) Response Time: Acknowledge new tickets and move to “In Progress” in under 30 minutes. Resolution Quality: Resolve tickets — including technically complex ones — with a focus on root-cause fixes rather than temporary workarounds. Same-Day Resolution: Strive to resolve 70%+ of tickets on the day they are opened, recognizing that complexity may extend some resolution times. Escalation Rate: Keep external/vendor escalations to a minimum, resolving the large majority of issues — including advanced ones — independently. Documentation Accuracy: Keep documentation for assigned clients current and audit ready. Platform Health: Maintain accurate, low-noise alerting and timely patch/backup remediation across monitored tools and clients. Client Trust: Clients should consistently feel informed, heard, and confident that the problem was solved. Maintain a 95%+ positive client satisfaction score and a low ticket reopen rate, demonstrating that clients can count on you to get it right the first time. Become the technician clients ask for by name! Requirements & Skills Education Education: High School Diploma or equivalent (GED) required. Associate or bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred. Certifications: Active certifications strongly preferred and weighted heavily in candidate evaluation — for example, Microsoft Certified: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate, Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert, Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), CompTIA Network+/Security+, or equivalent. Candidates without current certifications must demonstrate equivalent hands-on knowledge. Growth Commitment: Candidates must maintain and expand relevant certifications (Microsoft, CompTIA, or equivalent) as technology and client environments evolve. Technical Experience Experience: Minimum 2-5+ years of progressive experience supporting end users, servers, and networks in an MSP or corporate IT environment, with demonstrated ability to independently diagnose and resolve advanced technical issues. Core Stack: Strong working knowledge of Windows 10/11, Windows Server administration, Active Directory, Group Policy, and full-stack Microsoft 365 administration (Exchange Online, Entra ID, Intune, SharePoint/Teams). Cybersecurity Tools, Management & Analysis: Demonstrated hands-on experience administering, analyzing, and troubleshooting modern security tools and programs, including Zero Trust, PAM, MDM, MDR, EDR, SIEM, SOC, Vulnerability Scanning, Penetration Testing. Networking: Understanding of LAN/WAN architecture, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, firewalls, switching/routing, Wi-Fi, and VPN configuration. Tools: Hands-on experience with industry leading PSA, RMM and Documentation tools strongly preferred; comfort monitoring and tuning these platforms is a plus. Location: Candidates should currently reside within daily commuting distance of Spearfish, SD, to support the on-site nature of this role. Compensation Rate Non-Exempt Employee Hourly Rate: $21 - $28 - Depending on Experience Benefits Following a Probationary Period (Length Depending on Experience): 2 Weeks Paid Vacation/Yr. 7 Paid Company Holidays Heath Insurance Dental Insurance Vision Insurance Life Insurance Retirement Plan Cell Phone Stipend Certification Assistance Ready to Make Every Ticket Count? Anyone can close a ticket. We're looking for someone who closes the loop : the technician who finds the root cause, keeps the client informed, and leaves their technology better than they found it. At Northern Hills Technology, you won't be endlessly stuck in a queue of password resets. You'll dig into Active Directory, Microsoft 365 tenants, VLANs, and real security incidents. You'll also help shape the platforms that power our whole service model. You'll work shoulder to shoulder with a close-knit team in Spearfish, where your expertise is noticed, your growth is expected, and "Today, Not Tomorrow" is more than a slogan. If you're ready to trade a routine for real problem-solving and become the person clients trust to get it right the first time, we want to hear from you!

review_candidates.title: Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Firmus Technologies Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. Firmus AI Cloud Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. Why you’ll love working here As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come. We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap. Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute. What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them. Role Summary Firmus Technologies is seeking a skilled Network Engineer / Senior Network Engineer to join our Engineering and Technology team. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in leading the development of our network designs and supporting the network deployment for AI infrastructure projects. This role offers an exciting opportunity to work at the forefront of AI networking technology and contribute to the growth of AI infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Design, Implement and Maintain Network Infrastructure Architect, deploy, support the corporate LAN, WAN, WLAN, and VPN infrastructure. Ensure high availability, performance and security of on-premise and cloud-connected network services. Setup, configure and maintain secure site-tp-site VPNs, MPLS links, or private interconnects between data centres, customer site, cloud environments and partner networks. Network as Code and Automation Develop and maintain automated network configurations using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (eg: Ansible, Netbox, Python scripts) Implement CI/CD pipelines for network changes to improve speed, consistency, and auditability Automate routine tasks such as provisioning, backups and compliance checks. Network Security and Policy Enforcement Implement and manage firewall and security devices. Apply firewall rules, VLAN segmentation, ACLs and zero-trust principles to safeguard internal and external communications. Collaborate with SMC Security and Risk team to enforce policies and respond to security incidents. Operation Support Respond and resolve escalate network issues, outages and performance degradations across the SMC Corporate and Compute network infrastructure. Analyze logs, run diagnostics and coordinate with vendors, carriers as needed. Work with internal observability team to setup and maintain monitoring tools to proactively identify bottlenecks, errors and abnormal behaviours. Analyze trends for bandwidth, hardware utilization, and growth to inform scaling and make recommendation to procurement decisions. Design and rest redundant paths, failover mechanisms and DR playbooks to ensure uninterrupted connectivity during outages or maintenance. Participate in operation standby roster and on-call for time to time. Project Management and Stakeholder Management Support the deployment team in their project management and resource allocation for the network portion of AI cluster installations. Collaborate and work closely with Global Operation Centre, Software Defined Infrastructure team, Data Centre Infrastructure team and Solution Architects to support deployments and to maintain SLAs. Technology Expertise Maintain and expand expertise in physical network hardware and advanced networking technologies, including (i) NVIDIA InfiniBand; (ii) Spectrum Ethernet Platform, and (iii) RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE). Familiar with open source network operating systems such as Cumulus Linux and Sonic Maintain and expand expertise in NetDevOps practices to maintain software defined network infrastructure Provide technical support and troubleshooting for advanced networking technologies, escalating to vendors as needed. Mentor junior network engineers, assisting with their technical development. Stakeholder Management Work closely with both Firmus Engineering and Commissioning teams to align network infrastructure with customers’ requirements. Facilitate knowledge sharing and communication between teams and create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation. Maintain and build strong relationships with key technology partners and vendors and proactively manage and coordinate partner engagement on site. Skills & Experience Bachelor’s degree in network engineering, computer science, or a related technical field. 8+ years of experience in network engineering, with a focus on AI infrastructure. Experience in Linux systems especially host network configuration. Strong project management skills and experienced in complex technical projects. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Willingness to undertake international and/or domestic travel for on-site deployments and commissioning. Solid understanding of advanced networking technologies, particularly those related to AI would be highly advantageous. Hands-on experience with NVIDIA InfiniBand, Spectrum Ethernet Platform, and/or RDMA over Converged Ethernet (RoCE) preferred. Key Competencies Enterprise & AI network delivery (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPN) Secure connectivity (site-to-site VPN, MPLS, private interconnects) Network automation & NetDevOps (IaC, Ansible, Python, CI/CD) Network security (firewalls, VLANs, ACLs, zero-trust) Operations, monitoring & incident response AI networking tech (InfiniBand, Spectrum, RoCE) Linux networking fundamentals Cross-team collaboration & mentoring Location & Reporting Sydney, New South Wales, Australia Reporting to Senior Manager, Networking Employment Basis Full-time Diversity At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions. Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.
